title: Internal rotation pitch — growth pilot (notes for 1:1)
content:
Purpose
- Quick personal pitch to propose a 6-month role rotation from People Ops (talent programs) into People Partnering (embedded HR) as a growth pilot.
- Use this doc for the 1:1 next week, leave space for manager feedback and immediate next steps.

One-line ask
- Trial rotation starting 2026-03-01 for ~6 months; maintain current IC headcount but shift my scope to be 80% partnership / 20% program continuity.

Why now (concise rationale)
- Growth opportunity: I want to stretch into day-to-day partnering to build ops-to-partner translation muscle (coaching, complex escalations, cross-functional influence).
- Team need alignment: People Partnering has gap coverage for two mid-market accounts (B2B GTM org) in Q2; short runway to ramp someone with ops/process knowledge.
- Cross-pollination benefit: We can bake stronger productized people programs (onboarding, calibration) by having a partner with ops background.

Impact hypothesis (what success looks like)
- Short term (first 6 weeks): Own 2-3 partner meetings, lead one calibration session, reduce time-to-resolution on 1 priority escalated case from 10->6 days.
- Mid (3 months): Measurable improvement on partner satisfaction (pulse + qualitative notes) and fewer handoffs on program execution (fewer tickets to Talent Ops).
- Long (6 months): Documented runbook for partner-ops handoff; one program improvement that reduces admin overhead by an estimated 10-15% (time saved for partners).

How it preserves current work
- I will keep program owner responsibilities (quarterly comms, vendor check-ins) but delegate detailed ticket triage to Amalia during rotation.
- Weekly 1-hour sync with Talent Programs lead to catch up on escalations and ensure no backlog growth.

Risks & mitigations
- Program continuity risk: Create a two-week handover CSV of active tickets and a 30/60/90 monitoring dashboard; schedule overlap weeks with delegate.
- Ramp risk in partner role: 2-week shadowing with Noah, documented playbook for common partner scenarios, access to partner templates.
- Perception risk (others see movement as stepping away): Communicate pilot framing in team channel and to key stakeholders (People Leadership + GTM EMs).

Metrics to track (operate as OKRs-lite)
- Partner satisfaction: ad-hoc feedback + 1 post-rotation pulse (target +0.2 NPS relative baseline).
- Escalation response time: median days to resolution (target -20%).
- Program backlog size: tickets open >7 days (target no increase).

Manager talking points (for live 1:1)
- Quick ask/ask timeline: ask for go/no-go and any leader-level blockers by 2026-02-20 so we can announce and align.
- Why me: domain knowledge (programs + vendor mix), existing relationships with GTM leaders, high curiosity and coachability.
- Ask from manager: signal to People Leadership about pilot, agree on delegate (Amalia), permission to reallocate up to 20% of my current capacity for ramping tasks in month 1.
- What I will report back: weekly 1-pg status + one highlight/one risk each Friday.

Conversation scripts (short phrases to use)
- "My intent is to build partnership craft that will make our programs more adoptable across GTM. This is a time-boxed pilot—if it doesn't move metrics, we revert."
- "I will own the handover and ensure no black holes—daily digest and ops dashboard will prove continuity."

Potential fallback outcomes
- If critical blockers: pause rotation and convert to 3-month shadowing + formal training plan.
- If program backlog spikes: I step back to 50/50 split and run an expedited transition plan.

Open questions I need from manager in the 1:1
- Do we need a formal job code change or can this run as a temporary scope shift?
- Are there stakeholders you want me to loop in before announcing?
- What signals would make you recommend against the pilot?

Next steps (action checklist)
- [ ] Share draft with Noah and Amalia for quick sanity check (by 2026-02-14)
- [ ] Manager decision / go-no-go by 2026-02-20
- [ ] Prepare 2-week handover doc and ticket CSV (by 2026-02-27)
- [ ] Announce pilot to People Leadership + GTM EMs (target 2026-02-28)
- [ ] Week 0: shadowing plan with Noah (first 10 days)

Notes to self (short, messy)
- Keep language fragile/experimental, not "promotion"—frame as learning pilot.
- Collect concrete examples of partner wins to show signal at 30d.
- Keep an eye on bandwidth—don't let rotation become escape from hard program work.

Relevant links (for quick paste in 1:1)
- Rotation framework: https://confluence.redwood.company/display/PEOPLE/rotation-framework
- Proposed ticket handover template: /templates/ticket-handover-v2.csv

End of draft — leave room during 1:1 to capture manager edits below:
